sacraments.text: Submit completed application and supporting documents at least one week before chosen spiritual preparation session; parents and godparents must attend preparation and baptism. May choose one of three preparation sessions preceding baptism. Bulletin: preparation last Friday of odd months, baptism first/second Sunday following month. Specific 2026/27 date accordions were not readable in saved text.

June to following Easter Vigil; Tuesdays 20:00–22:00 JPII Hall, Parsonage Level 1. Welcomes unbaptised adults, Christians exploring Catholicism and baptised Catholics missing initiation sacraments. Forms from office or online; companion/service-team volunteers welcome.
Youths 16–23 exploring faith or baptised youths exceptionally not yet confirmed; Sunday 10:30–12:30 Isaiah Room, Parish Centre Level 2, after Easter to next Easter Vigil.

Contact office 12 months ahead for church/priest availability; complete booking form and MPC/EE. PNI with priest at least six months before wedding, bringing baptism extracts, course certificate and civil certificate if already solemnised. Book weekday rehearsal; NFP encouraged.

Contact office with name and number; priest calls back. Do not wait for critical illness; arrange before major surgery if appropriate. Anointing request form linked; hospital emergencies may contact priest from nearest parish.
Check office for priest and Mass availability before confirming crematorium time; office also arranges wake prayers.
Pastoral Services page links request forms for homebound Communion, house blessing/anointing, funeral, niche booking, census, and sacramental extracts/letters. No forms submitted.

Baptism 4 October/6 December 2026 at 14:30. Last 2026 preparation 20 November 20:00–21:15 (September 25 session already passed). Parents/godparents must attend both; choose any one of three preparation sessions preceding baptism. Complete documents at least one week before chosen preparation; incomplete applications not processed.
RCIY ages 16–23, submit form to rciy@sfxchurch.sg; RCIA ages 24+, submit form to rcia@sfxchurch.sg. Sponsor/companion form also available.
Confirm priest and Funeral Mass with office before crematorium arrangements. Office can arrange St Pio Prayer Group wake prayers. Funeral and niche forms linked.

Home Communion for illness, advanced age or limited mobility via request form. Anointing before planned hospital admission where possible; office arranges priest, emergencies may contact Catholic parish nearest hospital. House-blessing/anointing form linked.
K2/P1 register via child’s MyCatholic.sg account; other levels/transfers catechism@sfxchurch.sg. Baptism extract, Marriage/Confirmation letters via request form to office.
Preparation Fridays 20:00–21:15:29 January,19 March,21 May,23 July,24 September,19 November. Baptism Sundays 14:30:14 February,4 April,6 June,1 August,3 October,5 December. Dates subject to change.
